توازيت (form VI)
# تَوَازَيْتُ (tawāzaytu) /ta.waː.zaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَوَازَى (tawāzā)
# تَوَازَيْتَ (tawāzayta) /ta.waː.zaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَوَازَى (tawāzā)
# تَوَازَيْتِ (tawāzayti) /ta.waː.zaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَوَازَى (tawāzā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
